title: Find the first causal failure
prompt: Two independent release jobs ended with 'no artifact'. A: [a1] warning: cache miss; [a2] compile OK; [a3] package: dist/manifest.json missing, exit 2; [a4] publish skipped. B: [b1] warning: cache miss; [b2] compile: unknown type Duration, exit 1; [b3] package skipped; [b4] publish skipped. For A and B respectively give the first fatal line id in first (array), the stages to fix in stages (array), and the line ids showing that the shared warning alone does not prove a compiler failure in contrast (array: success, then failure).
